PackageDistro
The packages shipped with &GAP; are managed in the repository https://github.com/gap-system/PackageDistro, which holds a meta.json file per package, derived from its PackageInfo.g. It detects new package versions from their PackageInfoURL, opens a pull request for each and tests it; its README.md describes how packages are added, updated and removed.
To test a pull request to &GAP; against all packages, a collaborator comments @gap-package-distribution-bot test on it; see .github/workflows/package-distro-trigger.yml.
